items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday vs DEN; Rapoport/Schefter confirm not expected to play, McVay notes possible return next week vs PHI. Davante Adams has shown he can carry the load (42% target rate on 142 routes without Nacua).
items.why: Hip injury, limited progress per McVay; official doubtful listing
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 opportunity boost in routes/targets
items.opportunity: Adams 42% TPRR sans Nacua historically; high red-zone potential

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; Rapoport notes good longer-term news (no IR expected), Mariota starts. Positive elbow update.
items.why: Dislocated elbow, official out but week-to-week positive
items.implication: Mariota start; WAS pass game downgrade short-term, McLaurin etc impacted

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at IND. Confirmed by Rapoport and ETR OUT list.
items.implication: Target vacuum in HOU pass game; Schultz saw 28% share last time Collins out
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers especially TE

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs CIN; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but projected IN by Levitan. Coach: Warren will lead the group.
items.why: Toe injury, official out; Warren shoulder but LP and projected in
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns from Rodgers; Homer/Heidenreich backups
items.opportunity: Warren 15+ carries + targets expected; high snap share lead role

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Seeking early clarity on Zay Flowers (ham), AD Mitchell, DJ Moore. Big DFS main slate implications. Gibbs ceiling projection record 44.0.
items.why: Practice/LP indicators and internal projections; Gibbs sim ceiling high
items.implication: Start confidence for projected-ins; monitor Flowers etc for upgrades
items.opportunity: Warren lead role; Bowers/Evans full routes if in; Gibbs elite ceiling

items.text: Broncos RBs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report and good to go vs Rams; Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle). ETR lists both IN.
items.why: Cleared, off report; Coleman ankle out
items.implication: Full DEN backfield available; committee continues but both playable
items.opportunity: Snap/carry share for Dobbins/Harvey vs LAR

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RBs; vertical pass not working for Rodgers so expect checkdowns. Backups Homer and Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments on Warren leading + Dowdle out + Rodgers checkdown tendency
items.implication: Warren RB2/FLEX lock with volume spike

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core surgery, 6-8 weeks); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead RB (RB14 util), Dillon primary backup.
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back for CAR

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Collins out; IND allows 4th-most yds to TEs.
items.why: Elevated role sans Collins + TE-friendly matchup
items.opportunity: High target share in HOU offense

items.text: Davante Adams run 142 routes without Puka Nacua as Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Prior misses: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2. High opportunity with Nacua doubtful.
items.implication: Adams WR1 ceiling elevated this week
items.opportunity: 42% target rate, high volume routes expected

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak DAL run D + high prop
items.opportunity: High carry volume expected in favorable rush matchup

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 YPR to WRs.
items.why: High target/air yards share + soft matchup

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara; role not there (RB37 util).
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but Berry sees diminished role
